## Review checklist

- [ ] Target is develop, or this is a tested develop → main release.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria and failure paths checked.
- [ ] No secrets, private resident data, or unapproved utility data.
- [ ] Contracts, fixtures, and docs updated as needed.
- [ ] Migration/deployment impact and rollback documented if applicable.
- [ ] Requested another teammate’s review.
